content: iron-session (npm, currently 8.0.4, last published ~2 years ago but stable/feature-complete) provides stateless, encrypted-cookie sessions with no server-side session store needed - well suited to serverless functions since there's no persistent process to hold session state. Works with any Node request/response pair (not Next.js-specific). Given no session store requirement here (server-verified entitlement is re-checked from DB per request anyway), iron-session's sealed-cookie approach avoids adding a session table/Redis.
